crossRefs.note: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel…

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Zuar
people.line: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar

translations.web: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.
translations.bsb: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, drew near.
translations.kjv: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
